name: 贾斯汀·斯坦尼克
name_full: 贾斯汀·斯坦尼克 Justin Stanek
introduction: Justin Stanek is an American actor, model, and multidisciplinary creative known for his emotionally grounded performances and magnetic screen presence in projects like Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks (2025) and Good Company (2023). Originally from the East Coast, Stanek brings a background in theater and music to his work in film and television.Driven by a deep love of storytelling, Stanek has appeared in a range of independent short films, dramatic series, and digital content. His work is often marked by bold character choices and a strong sense of physicality, with a focus on roles that explore identity, resilience, and rebellion. He is also a vocalist and songwriter, with original music featured on his social media platforms.Outside of acting, Stanek has experience in visual design, production, and creative direction, bringing a holistic understanding of the filmmaking process to every set he steps on.Justin's goal is to aid in the development of original projects for film and streaming and continues to collaborate with fellow artists who are passionate about telling meaningful, unconventional stories.
